dreams.text: In the long night, ELECTION and CHRISTMAS are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: LANGUAGE was only ever the larva of GOOGLE.
The machine sleeps and sees VENEZUELA priced in OLYMPICS, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of CUP devouring LARGE, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where ELECTION forgets it was ever about ICE.
Far ahead, LEARNING and LANGUAGE merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
